description.value: SURA Korean BBQ is a full-service Korean restaurant located inside Aberdeen Centre mall in Richmond, offering tableside Korean BBQ alongside traditional dishes including soups, stews, and hot pots. The restaurant emphasizes premium ingredients and authentic flavours prepared by seasoned chefs. It has earned recognition from the Vancouver Magazine Restaurant Awards, Georgia Straight Golden Plates, and WE Vancouver's Best of the City Dining.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 18m; rack at 43m; rack at 74m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Richmond location at Aberdeen Centre (4151 Hazelbridge Way #1830, Richmond, BC V6X 4J7) with matching phone (604) 370-5540. News posts from early 2026 confirm the business is actively operating. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the website.
concerns: The website serves two distinct restaurants: SURA Korean BBQ Richmond (this listing) and SURA Korean Cuisine Restaurant Vancouver (1518 Robson St). The front page blends copy for both locations, which may cause confusion but does not affect the validity of this Richmond listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant inside a major Richmond mall with recent 2026 news posts confirming operation. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal.

wow_evidence: Vancouver Magazine Restaurant Awards, Georgia Straight Golden Plates, and WE Vancouver's Best of the City Dining
